senses.gloss: (cmp. צמם) to tie up, to muzzle (b. h. חָסַם).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 63b:20">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>זמות</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 30:32">Prov. XXX, 32</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00527">preced. w.</cite>) <he>אם ז׳ וכ׳</he> if he muzzles his mouth (is ashamed to ask his teacher), he will have to put his hand to the mouth (when he in turn is asked).
Ter. IX, 3 לא זוֹמֵם he does not muzzle his animal (complies with the law, Deut. XXV, 4); a. e.—Part. pass. זָמוּם, f. זְמוּמָה; pl. זְמוּמִים, זְמוּמוֹת muzzled, prevented from grazing.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59">Gen. R. s. 59</cite>, end; a. e.—Denom. <cite ref="G00533"><he>זְמָם</he> II</cite>.
